description: This file defines extension methods for the IGrainContext interface in the Orleans framework, specifically adding a method to retrieve grain extensions of a specified type.

classes.name: GrainContextComponentExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IGrainContext to access grain extensions.

methods.name: GetGrainExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a specific grain extension of type TComponent from the grain context. Throws an exception if no component binder is available.
